{
  "markdown": "# Exchange Rate and Domestic Interest Rate Relationship

## Key Insight
- **Exchange rate** and **domestic interest rate** move **together positively**.

## Graphical Representation
- The **exchange rate** is plotted on the **x‑axis**.
- The **domestic interest rate** is plotted on the **y‑axis**.

## Interest Parity Condition
- When the **domestic interest rate (i)** equals the **foreign (international) interest rate**, the **exchange rate** must equal the **expected exchange rate**.
- In this situation, **only the exchange rate can adjust** to restore indifference after any change.

## Summary
- The positive relationship can be expressed as:
  ```
  exchange_rate ↔ domestic_interest_rate (positive relationship)
  ```
- This relationship underlies the **interest parity condition** shown in the plotted UI.
"
